question: Where are a garden located within 70 kilometers range of Rock of the Marne, VA?
sql: SELECT poi_name AS garden_name FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rock of the Marne%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 70000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS garden_name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rock of the Marne%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 70000);

answers.garden_name: Pigtown Food For Thought Community Garden
